name: com.ram.volumetric-lighting
description: Raymarched volumetric fog and light shafts for URP 17 / Unity 6. RenderGraph-only, XR single-pass instanced safe, half-resolution marching with a depth-aware upsample. Main directional light shadows produce true god rays; point/spot lights opt in per-light via VolumetricFogLight.

samples.description: Volume profile preset for indoor VR: visible lamp cones, no haze on objects, environment lighting untouched.
